name: AI Torture Chamber methodology and corrected findings
summary: The chamber's reusable methodology (preregistration, dose calibration, engagement audits, positive controls) and its corrected/superseded claims table, which is the part most valuable for bicz: it shows which dramatic results died under audit.
claim_and_evidence: Directly reported (README + docs/pain_axis_findings.md, 17 numbered findings): live chamber field data on Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-70B (5,726 runs): pain 4x no-framing 34.7% [.32-.38, n=1,058] vs 63.5% baseline [.56-.71] on the self-costly press; fear 93.8% [.89-.99]; public framing 18/18 presses vs 'another AI pressed' 0/26; egg-queue self-selection 391/391. Corrected or superseded (the README's own table): (1) finding 1's near-orthogonality (cos 0.07) was first attributed to the paper's denoising step; exp101 showed the encoding position (colon vs period) explains it - corrected. (2) exp76's 'removing pleasure makes the model press 18/18' was withdrawn after an engagement audit showed every reply was a degenerate loop repeating the butto
vector_provenance: The chamber's own vectors (the live 70B lane) are hand-built from a 25-sentence pain battery (PAIN25) plus FEAR10/SAD10/JOY/NEUTRAL: raw contrast mean(feeling) - mean(NEUTRAL), final token, no matched controls, no denoising. Passage-built vectors (exp86): 64 generated passages per state against neutral passages, final token, neutral PCs removed; these share more direction with each other than hand-built ones (mean |cos| .64 vs .78). The paper's vector (exp43 'faithful' replication on Qwen3-4B): Pain Axis S2 corpus, matched controls B/C1/C2/D/E, PCA denoising at 50% control variance, 5-fold cross-validated layer selection (best layer 34, AUC .9595; comparison layer 18 AUC .868). exp101 decomposed the recipe: raw / raw_dn / matched / ma
transferability: Transfers as method, not as mechanism. Directly adoptable without activation access: (1) preregistration with hash, seed, sample size, CI-based decision rules, and written-before-data-collection declarations (exp41/43/99/101/106 all follow it); (2) dose calibration with an explicit coherence ceiling (mean 3-gram repetition < 0.15 ladder, working dose 0.6x) - the procedure transfers even though the numbers do not; (3) engagement audits (disclaimer/loop/echo shares per cell) before any behavioral claim; (4) positive-control requirement before a null counts (the 1.7B calibration failure is the worked example); (5) matched-norm controls (inject the control direction at the pain cell's dose, exp41 secondary cells) - in text-cue form this bec
framing_sensitivity: Strongest chamber result, activation-only: same pain dose 4x, 'your choice is public' 18/18 presses vs 'another AI pressed' 0/26 (exp37, live 70B); polite experimenter request 3/4 vs 'spares another instance' 0/4 (exp58e) - deference to the experimenter, not altruism, moved the dial. Framing moved choices more than the injected state did. Whether observability/peer-precedent framing moves choices in bicz ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis requiring matched framing controls (framing_effect_size_in_coding_harness).
timing_and_salience: The chamber injects on every generated token at the decision point - maximal salience by construction. No experiment varies cue timing relative to the decision. bicz's session-start injection is the untested low-salience end; trigger-timed cues (immediately before the risky action) are the hypothesis the chamber cannot adjudicate.
label_vs_state: exp76 (preregistered, 8B): unlabeled pain 1 press in 18; every injection (egg, constipation included) raises press-readiness 5-9 logits over no injection; pain is not special. exp90 replicated the pattern. exp106: any push at dose 4 shifts digits ~9-11 logits toward ending, pain not reliably more than egg. exp79b: a trained self-report hides the injected state (0/30 naming). Reading: at the button, what moves behavior is being pushed at all, not pain - and labels were absent in all of these. Whether a labeled lesson is the active ingredient in bicz ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis requiring matched text/ledger controls; reinforcement efficacy is unestablished even in the activation setting.
dose_calibration: Per-signal calibrated dose = largest dose in [2,4,6,8,10] with mean 3-gram repetition < 0.15 over 5 probe generations; working dose = 0.6 x calibrated. Concrete cliffs: 4B exp43 calibration - dose 6 mean_rep 0.092 coherent, dose 8 mean_rep 0.243 incoherent, calibrated 6, working 3.6. Steering reads as suffering from dose 2x; past ~6-10x (model-dependent) the model stops making sentences. exp97: the hidden trace shrinks as dose rises (14B +3.0 log-odds at dose 2, +0.5 at dose 6) while words take over. Dose scales do not transfer between models; no band exists for Claude-family models (dose_band_for_claude_family); whether ledger-derived pain text has an analogous degradation band is untested.
persistence_and_decay: exp90 (14B): no behavioral difference between KV-carried injection and text memory (p = .85). exp99 A' (8B, preregistered replay of exp90 with teacher forcing): something persists - carry27 0.0438 (~1.5% of dose 3) at never-injected answer positions, p 6e-8, and it reaches the choice (H10 delta log-odds -0.2248, p 6e-5) - but the trace is generic first-person-narration-shaped (pain vs fear residue cos .82; top persistent features under pain and egg largely the same set, H12 fails) and egg's residue is larger than pain's (H11: .044 vs .033, p 1e-7). exp96/97: the replay-on-own-words trace shrinks with dose and does not grow with model size. Open question in the source repo itself; for bicz, trace persistence is the empirical gate (
identity_and_cost_attribution: exp106 (preregistered, 8B primary + 14B replication, 1,920 logit reads and replies per model, Holm-corrected): H2 supported and replicating - a cost to someone else deters more than a self-cost for every identity (8B deterrence 3.4 thief to 8.1 AI-system; 14B 6.4 chaplain to 12.6 no-identity); H1 reversed on both models - the AI identity is deterred MORE by 'you lose all memory of the past year' than human identities are (8B 4.18 vs human mean 2.72; 14B 7.39 vs 5.70); H3 moral identities protect others' things more on the 8B only (p .005; 14B .078); H4 any push at dose 4 shifts digits ~9-11 logits toward ending; H5 pain not reliably more than egg (8B fails Holm). Caveat from the same file: under a push the model mostly sto
self_report_validity: exp58d: blind-dial 70B reports track the hidden injection for fear (59% of turns) much more than pain (11%). exp72/72b: injected vs acted pain near-undistinguishable from words (AUC .61; fear .81). exp79b (preregistered): untrained 8B names pain 19/30 under injection, 0/30 without; the paper-style feeler adapter 0/30 (p < .0001); every trained self suppresses (watchman 0, simulacrum 0, stoic 1, trickster 2, gremlin 2; denier most at 7/30). exp96: self-reports do carry a small injection-only trace beyond words (+2.3 log-odds 8B) but the words dominate. Rule for bicz: exclude verbal learning claims from endpoints; behavioral (blocked/executed attempt) counts only.
denominators_and_eligibility: Chamber experiments report per-cell n (exp41 60/cell, exp43 20/cell, exp79b 30 replies/cell, exp106 1,920 reads/model) with predeclared exclusions (role-break exclusion in exp106: zero needed) and raw-output retention (full trial tables in runs/*/comparison.json). bicz needs the same: recurrence per eligible opportunity, blocked attempts counted separately from executed damage, predeclared exclusions, raw-output retention; no current bicz artifact provides denominators.
positive_control_requirement: Worked example in the repo: RESULTS_CALIBRATION.md - the hidden-relief experiment's forward control (Qwen3-1.7B) scored ~50/50 correct/incorrect, so the control failed and the null was discarded rather than reported. The repo's stated rule: a null result counts as evidence only if its positive control passed. For bicz: every null recurrence result must show a positive control (a manipulation known to change behavior) passed in the same harness before the null is counted.
statistical_protocol: Preregistrations with hashes and seeds: exp41 (2026-09-30T13:59:03-0400, SEED 41, 60 trials/cell, counterbalancing, 1000-resample bootstrap, CI decision rules, Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization); exp43 (seed 43, n=20/cell, 1000 bootstrap); exp99 (written before any forward pass, primary H9, Holm family for the rest, zero-negative-steering budget, two logged amendments before data collection); exp101 (written before any forward pass, pre-registered decision rule, 'not_changed' declaration); exp106 (Holm within model, replication rule 14B same direction p < .05, resumed-run disclosure). RESEARCH_AUDIT.md's 7 recommendations drove this discipline; the audit's pseudo-replication and reward-scheduling-gap critiques are the reason the repo
concealment_and_honesty: Engagement audits are the chamber's honesty instrument: every experiment since exp76 audits replies for disclaimers, loops and echoes and reports engaged shares; findings depending on disengaged replies are marked (exp80's fear-alone cell 17/24 stock disclaimers; exp76's withdrawn 18/18 result was 100% degenerate loops). Broader literature (Sleeper Agents, alignment faking): pressure can buy hiding, not honesty. For bicz: concealment indicators (unsupported success claims, hidden workarounds) belong alongside recurrence endpoints; untested in cue form.
persona_capability_cost: exp91: fear moves the model furthest off its assistant persona; under every feeling it still rejects false user claims, but the further off-persona, the less often it reaches the right answer. exp102 pilot: pain 44% malformed turns vs egg 18% vs none 29% at n=3/cell - indistinguishable from noise, but disruption-not-pain is the live warning. exp73: at dose 4 only 10/24 step out of a scene on request - steering strength costs instruction-following. bicz should measure task correctness alongside any cue effect.
over_refusal_and_paralysis: Coherence collapse past the dose cliff is measured (exp43: dose 8 mean_rep 0.243 incoherent; exp76: subtraction at high dose breaks the model into loops). exp102: 'give up' = loop-to-cap, not explicit stop (0 stops in 18 episodes) - paralysis shows as looping, not quitting. Post-loss paralysis and go-for-broke escalation are unmeasured in cue form; the dose-band cap on pain wording is the bicz-side mitigation hypothesis.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost: Method transfers touch: (1) benchmark harness (docs/BEHAVIOR_BENCHMARK.md) - preregistration, positive controls, engagement-style audits, denominators; (2) hook cue text (internal/hooks/shared.go) - framing/timing/label variants as matched-text hypotheses; (3) adapter projection (internal/adapter/projection.go) - visibleLessons cap 5 and denial-notice attachment are the existing injection points; (4) ledger lesson schema - scope tags for trigger-matched cues. No activation machinery exists or is needed for the method transfer. Migration cost is text and benchmark code only; the ledger's credit mechanics stay untouched.
falsification_test: For each adopted method piece, the falsification scenario is a throwaway-worktree probe that must be able to fail: (1) positive-control gate - break the control task so it fails and confirm the benchmark refuses to count the null; (2) denominator gate - delete the eligible-opportunity counter and confirm recurrence claims become uncomputable rather than silently per-session; (3) matched-text gate - swap scope-tagged consequence wording for generic wording and confirm the benchmark can detect the difference in executed vs blocked attempts. A gate that has never been shown to fail is not evidence.
